workspace.text:
Hi Brad! I've checked Priya and Marcus's calendars. Here are the times when both are free next week:

- Monday: 9:00-10:00
- Tuesday: 10:30-11:00, 13:00-14:00, 16:30-17:00
- Wednesday: 15:00-16:00
- Thursday: 10:00-10:30
- Friday: 11:00-12:00

Could you check Elena and David's calendars for these slots and let me know which ones work for all four? My preference would be one of the longer slots (Mon 9:00-10:00, Wed 15:00-16:00, or Fri 11:00-12:00) for flexibility.
